english.title: Send communication threatening death or serious harm
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sent a message that conveyed a threat of

(A)_[death]_
(B)_[serious harm, namely **(..SPECIFY TYPE OF HARM..),]_

intending, or being reckless as to whether, an individual encountering the message would fear that the threat would be carried out
english.legislation: Contrary to section 181 of the Online Safety Act 2023.

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) From the 31st January 2024, this offence replaces that previously provided for by section 1(1)(a)(ii) of the Malicious Communications Act 1988 (H12180 - send letter / communication / article conveying a threatening message).
(ii) Section 185 of the Online Safety Act 2023 provides extra-territorial application and jurisdiction for this offence.
